answer: Guaranteed entry with decaying reputation blocks bulk fakes. A newcomer joins only if a sponsor stakes 60 credits; reputation starts full, like fresh saffron, and falls 5% each idle epoch, so copies fade. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 sponsors and 60,000 credits locked 20 epochs, and fraud slashes both together, stopping the spiral of cheap copies overrunning the shared meadow. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
